name: us-congress
description_ko: 미국 의회 회의록(Congressional Record)용. 의사진행 발언(만장일치 동의 요청, 발언권 양보 등)을 뺀다. 공인의 공개 발언이므로 원문 공개(public).
description_en: For the U.S. Congressional Record. Removes procedural turns (unanimous-consent requests, yielding time, quorum calls). Public officials' on-record statements, so text policy is public.
exclude_patterns: ^(Mr\.|Madam) (President|Speaker), I suggest the absence of a quorum
^(Mr\.|Madam) (President|Speaker), I have \w+ requests? for committees? to meet
had I been present, I would have voted
Without objection, it is so ordered
